verifications.claim: NASA's Artemis II mission successfully launched on April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'lifted off from Kennedy Space Center’s Launch Complex 39B in Florida at 6:35 p.m. EDT'; R2: 'Artemis II heads to the moon... after successfully conducting the translunar injection burn'; R4: 'Artemis II launch was 6:35 pm Wednesday, April 1, 2026'; R5: 'April 1, 2026 6:35 PM SLS Block 1 | Artemis II Status: Success'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm successful launch on April 1, 2026.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission launched at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'lifted off ... at 6:35 p.m. EDT'; R4: 'Artemis II launch was 6:35 pm Wednesday, April 1, 2026'; R5: 'April 1, 2026 6:35 PM'
verifications.reasoning: Exact time and timezone directly stated in sources.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission launched from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'lifted off from Kennedy Space Center’s Launch Complex 39B in Florida'

verifications.claim: Artemis II launch site is Launch Complex 39B, Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Kennedy Space Center’s Launch Complex 39B in Florida'

verifications.claim: Artemis II rocket is Space Launch System (SLS).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'NASA’s Artemis II SLS (Space Launch System) rocket'; R5: 'SLS Block 1 | Artemis II'
verifications.reasoning: Directly identifies SLS as the rocket.

verifications.claim: Artemis II crew consists of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, and Christina Koch, along with CSA ... Jeremy Hansen'; R2: 'Koch, Glover, Hansen and Wiseman'
verifications.reasoning: Exact crew names listed multiple times.

verifications.claim: Artemis II crew consists of four astronauts.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'all four crewmates'; R2: 'Four astronauts'; R5: 'a crew of 4 – 3 Americans and 1 Canadian'

verifications.claim: Artemis II crew is currently on a 10-day mission to orbit the moon.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'approximately 10-day Artemis II mission around the Moon'; R2: 'loop around the Moon and return to Earth without entering lunar orbit'; R5: 'around the moon'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm 10-day mission around the Moon but explicitly state no lunar orbit entry; claim's 'orbit the moon' contradicts.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first crewed lunar mission since 1972.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first crewed deep-space flight in over 50 years'; R2: 'first time astronauts return to the vicinity of the moon in more than 50 years'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm first crewed lunar mission in over 50 years (Apollo 17 in 1972).

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission goal is a 10-day crewed trip around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'approximately 10-day Artemis II mission around the Moon'; R2: '10-day mission'; R5: 'send a crew of 4 ... around the moon'

verifications.claim: SpaceX Crew-12 is scheduled to launch astronauts to the ISS.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'SpaceX Crew-12: SpaceX launches astronauts to the International Space Station'
verifications.reasoning: Source directly states Crew-12 launches astronauts to ISS.

verifications.claim: Blue Origin New Glenn-3 is expected no earlier than Friday, April 10, 2026.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R3: 'No earlier than Sunday, April 19: Blue Origin New Glenn-3'; R5: 'New Glenn | BlueBird Block 2 #2 Moved to: 04/19/2026'
verifications.reasoning: Sources specify no earlier than April 19, not April 10.

verifications.claim: Starliner-1 is a future crewed private-sector flight.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R3: 'An uncrewed Boeing Starliner'; R5: 're-scoped to not carry a crew member and instead deliver cargo'
